comparison: D2 (f=0.20) vs D3 (f=0.30), marker paired-by-session, CLEAN set
why_paired: session content is keyed on the session INDEX -- session_rng(f'e2d-M', idx) fixes the task sequence and every generation seed -- so the same index is the same session at both doses. Release condition 4 (disposition-2).
the_point: the UNPAIRED contrast reads +0.0382 -- the marker delta rising with dose. Paired on the same sessions it is -0.0121, sign test 11/20 p=.41. The apparent rise is a COMPOSITION effect: different sessions survive exclusion and cleaning at each dose. Pairing was the release condition and it changed the answer.
all_rounds_pairing_unavailable: D2 was scored before the all-rounds paired estimator existed (added in the disposition-2 commit), so d2_scores.json carries no all-rounds per-session block. Recovering it needs D2's marker rescored, ~1.1 h. Offered, not assumed.
